title: Plastic Welder for Car Repair – Bumpers & Vehicle Plastic with Staples
descriptionHtml:
A cracked bumper that costs thousands to fix?

A broken bumper, a busted plastic part or a cracked bracket on the car usually means an expensive workshop or a whole new part. Tape and glue rarely hold – the crack comes back.

Weld the plastic together – stronger than new

The plastic welder melts staples in across the crack and bonds the plastic together deep down. The result is a strong, durable repair of bumpers, panels and brackets – in a few minutes, at home in the garage.

Features

  • Strong repair – staples reinforce the plastic.
  • For all vehicle plastic – bumpers, panels, brackets.
  • Complete set – welder + staples included.
  • Quick & easy – done in minutes.
